class.name: NNHTNExecutionSettings
class.brief_description: How an [NNHTNRoot] replaces a running plan and recovers from a failed step.
class.description: Assign to [member NNHTNRoot.execution_settings]. Without it the root uses these defaults: a new plan replaces the running one at once, there is no switching threshold, and a failed plan is followed by a search from the domain. See [b]Replacing a running plan[/b] and [b]Local repair[/b] in [NNHTNRoot]. Invalid values are not clamped: they are listed by [method get_validation_errors], shown as configuration warnings on the root, and make the root do nothing until fixed.

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns one message per invalid value. Empty when the settings are valid.

members.member: What a newly found plan does to a step that has started and is still available: [constant IMMEDIATE] replaces the running plan at once (cancelling the step unless [member NNHTNTask.resumable] keeps it), while [constant FINISH_CURRENT_STEP] lets the started step finish before installing or replanning.

After a step fails or is invalidated, first try to re-decompose only the method around it, keeping the completed steps and the rest of the plan, before searching from the domain. See [b]Local repair[/b] in [NNHTNRoot].

Under [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.RANKED], a new plan replaces a running plan whose current step is still available only when its utility exceeds the running plan's by more than this. Utility is the sum of the [member NNHTNMethod.priority] of the methods that produced a plan (see [method NNHTNRoot.get_last_search_result]). Must be finite and non-negative; [code]0.0[/code] switches on any change. A proven [constant NNHTNRoot.NO_PLAN], an unavailable current step and [method NNHTNRoot.request_replan] with [code]urgent[/code] still switch immediately. The other policies ignore it.

constants.constant: A new plan replaces the running one as soon as it is found. The started step is cancelled unless it is kept because it is [member NNHTNTask.resumable].

A new plan found while a step is running, or verifying, and still available waits for that step to finish. Meanwhile no later step of the running plan starts. When the new plan's first step is the same occurrence as the running step (see [member NNHTNTask.resumable] for what counts as the same), the rest of the new plan is installed once the step succeeds, without searching again. Otherwise the root searches again once the step has finished. Only the newest plan waits. A failure or invalidation of the step, a proven [constant NNHTNRoot.NO_PLAN] and [method NNHTNRoot.request_replan] with [code]urgent[/code] end the wait at once. Dependency changes raised during the wait are searched right after the waiting plan is installed; [method NNHTNRoot.request_replan] still searches on the next tick and replaces the waiting plan with a newer one.
